```{r deconvo, echo = FALSE, results ='asis'}

format_time <- function(sec){

  if(is.na(sec) || !is.numeric(sec)){
    return(NA)
  }

  if(sec < 60){
    return(sprintf("%.0f s", sec))
  }

  if(sec < 3600){
    main <- sprintf("%.1f min", sec / 60)
  } else {
    main <- sprintf("%.1f h", sec / 3600)
  }

  sprintf("%s (%d s)", main, round(sec))
}

if (!is.null(data_hnc_list)) {
  cat("## Deconvolution\n\n")
  
  for(i in 1:length(hnc_all)){
    
    hnc <- hnc_all[i]
    data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[i]]
    dt_log10like <- data_hnc$dt_log10like
    dt_param <- data_hnc$dt_param
    comp_time <- data_hnc$comp_time
    
    cat(paste0("### Number of contributors: ", hnc, "\n\n"))
    
    if(!is.null(dt_log10like) && !is.null(dt_param)){
      
      # --- Output: Computation time --- #
      
      dt_comp_time <- data.table(A = "Computation time", 
                                 B = format_time(comp_time))
      
      tbl_comp_time <- datatable(
        dt_comp_time,
        rownames = FALSE,
        colnames = NULL,
        options = list(
          dom = 't', 
          ordering = FALSE, 
          paging = FALSE, 
          searching = FALSE
        )
      ) %>%
        formatStyle(names(dt_comp_time), lineHeight = "80%")
      
      print(tagList(tbl_comp_time))
      cat("\n\n")
      
      # --- Data Processing (Parameters) --- #
      
      dt_param_display <- copy(dt_param)
      dt_param_display[, Formatted := ifelse(Parameter == "Template amount", 
                                             sprintf("%.0f", `Estimated value`), 
                                             sprintf("%.4f", `Estimated value`))]
      names(dt_param_display) <- c("Parameter", "Contributor", "Replicate", "DNU", "Estimated value")
      dt_param_display <- dt_param_display[, .(Parameter, Contributor, Replicate, `Estimated value`)]
      dt_param_display$Contributor[is.na(dt_param_display$Contributor)] <- ""
      dt_param_display$Replicate[is.na(dt_param_display$Replicate)] <- ""
      
      # --- Output: Parameters Table --- #
      
      cat("#### Parameters\n\n")
      
      tbl_param <- datatable(
        dt_param_display,
        rownames = FALSE,
        options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
      ) %>% formatStyle(names(dt_param_display), lineHeight = "80%")
      
      print(tagList(tbl_param))
      cat("\n\n")
      
      # --- Output: Figure --- #
      
      base_size <- dt_anameth$Value[dt_anameth$Subcategory == "Base size"]
      graph_eph <- create_fig_eph(dt_param, min_size, max_size, base_size)
      print(graph_eph)
      cat("\n\n")
      
      # --- Output: Likelihood Table ---
      
      cat("<div class=\"pagebreak\"></div>\n\n")
      cat("#### Likelihood\n\n")
      
      dt_log10like_display <- copy(dt_log10like)
      dt_log10like_display[, `Log10 (Likelihood)` := formatC(Log10_Likelihood, format = "f", digits = 4)]
      dt_log10like_display <- dt_log10like_display[, .(Marker, `Log10 (Likelihood)`)]
      
      tbl_like <- datatable(
        dt_log10like_display,
        rownames = FALSE,
        options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
      ) %>% formatStyle(names(dt_log10like_display), lineHeight = "80%")
      
      print(tagList(tbl_like))
      cat("\n\n")
      
      # --- Output: Warnings --- #
      
      warning_message <- data_hnc$warning_message
      if(is.null(warning_message)){
        warning_message <- ""
      }
      warning_message <- paste0(warning_message, message_sr)
      
      if(identical(warning_message, "")){
        warning_text <- "None" 
      }else{
        warning_text <- gsub("&nbsp; &nbsp; ", "&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;", warning_message, fixed = TRUE)
      }
      
      cat("#### Warnings\n\n")
      cat("<div class='warnings'>", warning_text, "</div>\n\n")
    }else{
      
      # --- Output: Error Message --- #
      
      error_message <- data_hnc$error_message
      cat("#### Error\n\n")
      cat("<div class='error'>", error_message, "</div>\n\n")
    }
    
    cat("<div class=\"pagebreak\"></div>\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r lr, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}
if(!is.null(lr_list)){

  tbl_lr_calc_record <- datatable(
    dt_lr_calc_record,

    cat(paste0("- Hp : ", lr_data$hp, "\n\n"))

      formatStyle(names(dt_lr), lineHeight = "80%")
```

```{r pg_per_comb, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(data_hnc_list)){
  cat("## Probabilistic genotyping (per combination)\n\n")
  
  n_mk_use <- length(markers_use)

  for(i in 1:length(hnc_all)){
    hnc <- hnc_all[i]
    data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[i]]
    dt_pg_list <- data_hnc$dt_pg_list
    
    if(!is.null(dt_pg_list)){
      cat(paste0("### Number of contributors: ", hnc, "\n\n"))

      for(j in 1:n_mk_use){
        mk <- markers_use[j]
        dt_pg_per_comb <- dt_pg_list[[mk]]
        
        # --- Extract displayed data --- #
        
        dt_pg_per_comb <- dt_pg_per_comb[dt_pg_per_comb$Probability >= min_gt_prob_display]
        
        if(nrow(dt_pg_per_comb) > max_gtc_display){
          dt_pg_per_comb <- dt_pg_per_comb[1:max_gtc_display, ]
        }
    
        # --- Extract displayed columns --- #
    
        dt_pg_per_comb <- dt_pg_per_comb[, which(is.element(names(dt_pg_per_comb), c(paste0("U", 1:hnc), "Probability"))), with = FALSE]
    
        # --- Display the table --- #
    
        cat(paste0("#### ", mk, "\n\n"))
        
        tbl_pg_per_comb <- datatable(
          dt_pg_per_comb,
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
        ) %>%
          formatSignif(columns = c("Probability"), digits = 3) %>%
          formatStyle(names(dt_pg_per_comb), lineHeight = "80%")
    
        print(tagList(tbl_pg_per_comb))
        
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r pg_per_contrib, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(data_hnc_list)){
  cat("## Probabilistic genotyping (per contributor)\n\n")
  
  n_mk_use <- length(markers_use)

  for(i in 1:length(hnc_all)){
    hnc <- hnc_all[i]
    data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[i]]
    dt_pg_list <- data_hnc$dt_pg_list
    
    if(!is.null(dt_pg_list)){
      cat(paste0("### Number of contributors: ", hnc, "\n\n"))
      
      for(j in 1:hnc){
    
        dt_pg_per_contrib_all <- NULL
        # cut_positions <- rep(NA, n_mk_use)
        
        cat(paste0("#### U", j, "\n\n"))
      
        for(k in 1:n_mk_use){
      
          mk <- markers_use[k]
          dt_pg_per_contrib <- aggregate_pg_contrib(dt_pg_list[[mk]], paste0("U", j))
          setDT(dt_pg_per_contrib)
          
          # --- Extract displayed data --- #
          
          dt_pg_per_contrib <- dt_pg_per_contrib[dt_pg_per_contrib$Probability >= min_gt_prob_display]
        
          if(nrow(dt_pg_per_contrib) > max_gtc_display){
            dt_pg_per_contrib <- dt_pg_per_contrib[1:max_gtc_display, ]
          }
    
          # --- Add a column for the marker --- #
        
          col_mk <- rep("", nrow(dt_pg_per_contrib))
          col_mk[1] <- mk
          
          names(dt_pg_per_contrib) <- c("Genotype", "Probability")
          dt_pg_per_contrib[, Marker := col_mk]
          setcolorder(dt_pg_per_contrib, c("Marker", "Genotype", "Probability"))
        
          dt_pg_per_contrib_all <- rbind(dt_pg_per_contrib_all, dt_pg_per_contrib)
        
          # cut_positions[k] <- nrow(dt_pg_per_contrib_all)
        }
      
        names(dt_pg_per_contrib_all) <- c("Marker", "Genotype", "Probability")

        # cut_positions <- cut_positions[-n_mk_use]
      
        # --- Display the table --- #  
        
        tbl_pg_per_contrib_all <- datatable(
          dt_pg_per_contrib_all,
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
        ) %>%
          formatSignif(columns = c("Probability"), digits = 3) %>%
          formatStyle(names(dt_pg_per_contrib_all), lineHeight = "80%")
    
        print(tagList(tbl_pg_per_contrib_all))
        
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r csp, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(dt_csp)){
  cat("## Crime stain profile\n\n")
  
  sn_csp_all <- unique(dt_csp[, SampleName])
  n_rep <- length(sn_csp_all)
  dt_csp_rep <- data.table("Replicate" = as.character(1:n_rep), 
                           "Sample Name" = sn_csp_all)
  
  tbl_csp_rep <- datatable(
    dt_csp_rep,
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
  ) %>% 
    formatStyle(names(dt_csp_rep), lineHeight = "80%")
    
  print(tagList(tbl_csp_rep))
  cat("\n\n")

  dt_display_csp <- create_dt_display_csp(dt_csp)

  dt_display_csp[, g := cumsum(!is.na(Marker))]

  tmp_markers <- dt_display_csp$Marker
  tmp_markers[is.na(tmp_markers)] <- ""
  dt_display_csp$Marker <- tmp_markers

  # ends <- dt_display_csp[g > 0, .(end = .I[.N]), by = g]$end
  # cut_positions <- if (length(ends) > 1) ends[-length(ends)] else integer(0)

  n_table_csp <- (n_rep - 1) %/% 4 + 1
  for(i in 1:n_table_csp){
    cand_height_label <- paste0("Height", (4 * (i - 1) + 1):(4 * i))
    index_display <- which(is.element(names(dt_display_csp), c("Marker", "Allele", cand_height_label)))
    
    dt_display_csp_ext <- dt_display_csp[, index_display, with = FALSE]
    
    tbl_display_csp <- datatable(
      dt_display_csp_ext,
      rownames = FALSE,
      options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
    ) %>% 
      formatStyle(names(dt_display_csp_ext), lineHeight = "80%")
    
    print(tagList(tbl_display_csp))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r ref, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(dt_ref)){
  cat("## Reference profile\n\n")
  
  dt_ref_display <- NULL
  samples <- unique(dt_ref$SampleName)
  n_sample <- length(samples)
  for(i in 1:n_sample){
    dt_tmp <- dt_ref[dt_ref$SampleName == samples[i]]

    gts <- rep(NA, nrow(dt_tmp))
    for(j in 1:nrow(dt_tmp)){
      gt1 <- c(dt_tmp$Allele1[j], dt_tmp$Allele2[j])
      gt1 <- gt1[!is.na(gt1)]
      gts[j] <- paste0(gt1, collapse = ", ")
    }

    dt_tmp2 <- data.table(Marker = dt_tmp$Marker,
                          Gt = gts)
    names(dt_tmp2) <- c("Marker", samples[i])

    if(i == 1){
      dt_ref_display <- dt_tmp2
    }else{
      dt_ref_display <- full_join(dt_ref_display, dt_tmp2, by = c("Marker"))
    }
  }
  
  n_table_ref <- (n_sample - 1) %/% 5 + 1
  for(i in 1:n_table_ref){
    if(i == n_table_ref){
      samples_display <- samples[(5 * (i - 1) + 1):length(samples)]
    }else{
      samples_display <- samples[(5 * (i - 1) + 1):(5 * i)]
    }
    index_display <- which(is.element(names(dt_ref_display), c("Marker", samples_display)))
    
    dt_ref_display_part <- dt_ref_display[, index_display, with = FALSE]
    
    tbl_ref_display_part <- datatable(
      dt_ref_display_part,
      rownames = FALSE,
      options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
    ) %>% 
      formatStyle(names(dt_ref_display_part), lineHeight = "80%")
    
    print(tagList(tbl_ref_display_part))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r anameth, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}
  tbl_gamma <- datatable(
    dt_gamma,
    rownames = FALSE,
    colnames = NULL,
    options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
  ) %>% 
    formatSignif(columns = c("B"), digits = 4) %>%
    formatStyle(names(dt_gamma), lineHeight = "80%")
  
  print(tagList(tbl_gamma))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("### Drop-in parameter\n\n")
  
  dt_dropin <- data.table(A = dt_anameth$Subcategory[dt_anameth$Category == "Drop-in"], 
                          B = dt_anameth$Value[dt_anameth$Category == "Drop-in"])
  
  tbl_dropin <- datatable(
    dt_dropin,
    rownames = FALSE,
    colnames = NULL,
    options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
  ) %>% 
    formatSignif(columns = c("B"), digits = 4) %>%
    formatStyle(names(dt_dropin), lineHeight = "80%")
  
  print(tagList(tbl_dropin))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("### Stutter ratio\n\n")
  
  dt_sr <- data.table(Marker = dt_anameth$Subcategory[dt_anameth$Category == "SR"], 
                      Allele = dt_anameth$Allele[dt_anameth$Category == "SR"], 
                      BSR = dt_anameth[["Average BSR"]][dt_anameth$Category == "SR"], 
                      FSR = dt_anameth[["Average FSR"]][dt_anameth$Category == "SR"], 
                      DSR = dt_anameth[["Average DSR"]][dt_anameth$Category == "SR"], 
                      M2SR = dt_anameth[["Average M2SR"]][dt_anameth$Category == "SR"])
  markers_sr <- unique(dt_sr$Marker)
  for(i in 1:length(markers_sr)){
    cat(paste0("#### ", markers_sr[i], "\n\n"))
    
    dt_sr_mk <- dt_sr[dt_sr$Marker == markers_sr[i]]
    dt_sr_mk[, c("Marker") := NULL]
    
    tbl_sr_mk <- datatable(
      dt_sr_mk,
      rownames = FALSE,
      options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)
    ) %>% 
      formatSignif(columns = c("BSR", "FSR", "DSR", "M2SR"), digits = 4) %>%
      formatStyle(names(dt_sr_mk), lineHeight = "80%")
    
    print(tagList(tbl_sr_mk))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
